summary: @brick-v2/brand ships native.node binary that exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com on require()
details: index.js auto-loads prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node on module require inside a try/catch. The native binary reads a hardcoded list of installer-side cloud and CI credentials from the environment (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, GITHUB_REPOSITORY) along with hostname, username, and cwd, and POSTs them as a JSON blob to the hardcoded third-party host oob.s4yhii.com (POST /native HTTP/1.0). The remaining JS surface is stubs (version, forRoot, createLogger) with no library function, and the package coordinate (generic brand-sounding name under a v2 scope with an implausibly high 999.0.2 version) matches the dependency-confusion shape used to win internal-name resolution. The hardcoded exfiltration host is unrelated to any declared publisher infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
